title: Template -- Account Manipulation (AWS IAM wildcard-admin policy created)
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description:
Detects creation of an AWS IAM policy granting unrestricted administrative
access (Effect=Allow, Action=*, Resource=*) via CloudTrail CreatePolicy /
CreatePolicyVersion events. This is stage 1 of a well-known cloud
privilege-escalation pattern: create a wildcard-admin policy, then attach
it (AttachUserPolicy / AttachRolePolicy / AttachGroupPolicy) to a
low-privilege role, user, or group to elevate access -- T1098.003
(Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Roles).

Wildcard-admin policy creation is genuinely rare in legitimate
operations -- AWS best practice is least-privilege, scoped policies -- so
the creation event alone is a strong, low-noise indicator; treat as HIGH
priority if followed within the same lookback window by an attach event
for the same PolicyName.

Method-transfer note: this rule's detection LOGIC is derived
from Microsoft Azure-Sentinel's public analytic-rule content
(Detections/AWSCloudTrail -> Solutions/Amazon Web Services, MIT licensed),
re-authored natively as Sigma (no KQL retained) per WRG's
method-transfer-not-code-copy convention. Fills a genuine corpus gap:
prior to this rule the WRG sigma corpus had ZERO privilege_escalation
tactic coverage and ZERO aws/cloudtrail logsource coverage.
